17   2026 subpoena to produce documents that was served on Silva’s Financial Services, LLC
18   (“Silva’s”) pursuant to Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 45, seeking documents and
19   communications from January 1, 2022 to the present related to financial and accounting services
20   provided to one or more of the Defendants, including tax returns, having considered the positions
21   of the parties and Silva’s, including that the disclosure of such documents and communications
22   may not be disclosed under applicable federal and/or state statutes including Florida or

26   2026 subpoena within five business days of this Order.
27
